enemies.name: Skeleton
enemies.notes: Arrows deal 1 less damage, minimum 1. Magic and melee deal full damage.

enemies.name: Zombie
enemies.notes: Kills raise a 2 HP zombie next round; at most 2 per battle. Raised zombies cannot raise others.

enemies.name: Bone Archer
enemies.notes: Individual fighter; fixed damage, no armor or special abilities.

enemies.name: Ogre
enemies.notes: Prepares a heavy strike for one turn, then attacks for +2 damage without moving. Move away to avoid it.

enemies.name: Warlock
enemies.notes: Summons skeletons from round 2; at most 2 living summons. Killing the Warlock wins.

enemies.name: Imp
enemies.notes: After attacking, hops one open adjacent hex away from its target.

enemies.notes: Individual fighter; fixed damage, no armor or special abilities.

enemies.notes: Melee damage heals 1 HP, capped at starting health.
